episode: How can black holes slow down time?
claim: A clock deeper in a gravitational field runs more slowly relative to a clock far away.

sources.title: Gravitational time dilation
sources.excerpt: Gravitational time dilation is an actual difference of elapsed time between clocks at different distances from a gravitating mass.

sources.title: General relativity
sources.excerpt: In the theory of general relativity, clocks in different gravitational potentials measure different elapsed times.
